what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from India in Germany: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 755 Indian asylum seekers in Germany, 0.4% of all asylum seekers from India.
Refugees from India, a separate group, live mostly in Canada, the United States, Portugal and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kashmir territory in India from 1995 to 2025, and over the government of India from 1996 to 2025.
The fact pack does not link these conflicts to the asylum figures.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 523 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 3658, at the end of 2015; the main years of displacement in the data are 2014 to 2016 and 2023.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Germany only.
